name: caps
_note: CAPS (Chess Alpha-beta Pruning Search) is part of the `motors` workspace by ToTheAnd. Build via `make` in the repo root → runs `cargo rustc --release ... -- --emit link=caps`, producing the `caps` binary at the repo root. CAPS speaks UCI/UGI; on first launch it's in interactive mode, so the descriptor's setup sends `uci` to switch to non-interactive UCI mode before perft cases run. By default `go perft N` is multi-threaded (rayon-parallelised via gears/perft.rs); `go perft N threads 1` forces single-threaded. Note: the engine rejects `threads K` for K>1 in perft mode — only 0 (default, parallel) or 1 are accepted. So multi-no-cache uses no inline threads override, single-no-cache appends `threads 1`. Perft output ends with `Nodes searched: <N>`.
